svg.title: Luna Mini · 垂直对称飞船
svg.desc: 1024 by 1024 editable vector rocket, pointing vertically upward. The rounded ivory hull, orange nose, circular blue glass porthole and coaxial nozzle retain the attached SVG style. Both orange fins use exactly mirrored shapes and matched surface treatments. The nose, porthole, hull and nozzle share the x=512 center line. Transparent background; no exhaust; no embedded bitmap images.
